newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Yield down on Bulgaria 3-, 12-mth discount T-bills.
newsitem.headline: Yield down on Bulgaria 3-, 12-mth discount T-bills.

text.p: Yields fell at Monday's auctions of Bulgaria's Finance Ministry three- and 12-month discount T-bills as the issues were heavily oversubscribed, Finance Ministry figures showed.

The three-month paper yielded 1.36 percent, down from 1.53 percent for the respective maturity auctioned a week ago and yield to maturity on the 12-month issue fell to 8.74 percent from 11.23 percent at the July 7 auction.
The two issues auctioned on Monday were offered with no minimum acceptable prices set in advance.
Details of the issues follow. Prices in percent of par:
Par value 10 bln levs 35 bln levs
Bids received 34.37 bln levs 113.021 bln levs
Average price of bids 98.37 pct 91.15 pct
Bids approved 10 bln levs 35 bln levs
Average yield to maturity 1.36 pct 8.74 pct
